source_entities.name: Michael Thomas
source_entities.summary: Pastor of the Chapel of Contemplation and executor of Walter Corbitt's will; sentenced for five murders, he escaped prison in 1917 and fled the state.

source_entities.name: Chapel of Contemplation
source_entities.summary: A church linked to Corbitt and Michael Thomas, closed in 1912 after allegations, a deadly raid, and arrests.

source_entities.name: Chapel of Contemplation raid
source_entities.summary: A secret 1912 police raid caused police and cult deaths, mass arrests, and an apparently suppressed public record.

source_entities.name: Corbitt House
source_entities.summary: The Boston house investigated in the scenario, including its upper story, ground floor, and sealed basement spaces.

source_entities.name: Corbitt's ritual dagger
source_entities.summary: An ornate rusted dagger animated by Corbitt; if turned against him, it can bypass his protection and destroy him.

source_entities.name: Liber Ivonis
source_entities.summary: A damaged Latin Mythos tome found with Chapel records; study grants Mythos knowledge at a Sanity cost.

source_entities.name: Corbitt Diaries
source_entities.summary: Three bound diaries describing Corbitt's occult experiments and a summoning spell.

source_entities.name: Rat pack
source_entities.summary: A swarm of rats nesting in the basement crawl space that may overwhelm an investigator.

source_entities.name: Dominate (Corbitt's variant)
source_entities.summary: Corbitt can cloud one investigator's mind while the target remains inside the house.

source_entities.name: Flesh Ward
source_entities.summary: Corbitt begins protected by variable magical armor that wears away as it absorbs damage.

handouts.title: Handout 1: Mr. Knott's Commission
handouts.summary: The commission, payment, keys, address, and suggested research routes.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When Mr. Knott explains the commission and hands over the keys and advance payment.

handouts.title: Handout 2: Unpublished Boston Globe Story (1918)
handouts.summary: An unpublished summary of the house's succession of afflicted tenants.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators find the unpublished 1918 story in the Boston Globe clipping files.

handouts.title: Handout 3: The House Is Built (1835)
handouts.summary: The earliest recorded construction and transfer to Walter Corbitt.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators find the house's earliest property record at the Central Library.

handouts.title: Handout 4: Neighbors Sue Corbitt (1852)
handouts.summary: The neighbors' attempt to force Corbitt from the area.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators find the neighbors' 1852 lawsuit at the Central Library.

handouts.title: Handout 5: Corbitt's Obituary and Burial Lawsuit
handouts.summary: Corbitt's obituary and the dispute over burial in his basement.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators find Corbitt's 1866 obituary and burial dispute at the Central Library.

handouts.title: Handout 6: No Recorded Outcome
handouts.summary: The second lawsuit has no recorded resolution.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators continue tracing the second lawsuit and discover that no outcome was recorded.

handouts.title: Handout 7: Corbitt's Executor and the Chapel
handouts.summary: The will executor links Corbitt to Reverend Michael Thomas and the closed Chapel.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators find the will executor and church-register records at the Hall of Records.

handouts.title: Handout 8: The Secret Chapel Raid
handouts.summary: The police raid, casualties, arrests, interference, and Michael Thomas's sentence and escape.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators obtain the Chapel raid file from the higher courts or Central Police Station.

handouts.title: Handout 9: Symbol of the Chapel of Contemplation
handouts.summary: The staring eye formed by three Y-shapes.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators clearly see the freshly painted white symbol at the Chapel ruins.

handouts.title: Corbitt House Investigator Map
handouts.summary: An unnumbered player map of the upper story, ground floor, and basement.
handouts.when_to_deliver: When the investigators enter the Corbitt House and need a spatial reference while exploring its floors.
